name: Workspace Export
description: Implement workspace export: serialize workspace configuration, session history, artifact metadata, and repository attachments into a portable format. Import on another machine: deserialize and rebuild workspace state, re-attaching repositories and restoring configuration. Include migration for repository paths and machine-specific settings.
purpose: Developers work across multiple machines and need to bring their workspace context with them. Export/import enables workspace mobility — start a session on a desktop, pick it up on a laptop, or onboard a new team member with a pre-configured workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Export serializes: workspace config, session history, artifact metadata, repository attachment list, ignore/inclusion policies
Export format is portable across platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Export file is standalone — does not reference absolute paths or machine IDs without migration mappings
Import deserializes workspace state, re-attaches repositories (clone if needed)
Import includes a repository path migration map (remap /home/user/proj to D:\Projects)
Import preserves workspace identity by default, optionally generates new identity
Import validates compatibility (Tribunus version, schema version, plugin versions)
Export/import supports selective components (config only, history only)
Export file is encrypted with user-provided key (optional)
